track: Round 9 reanalysis, task B: tissue-placement Monte Carlo on the invariant five-rung barrier profile with full rung-level bootstrap
convention: theta = U_d/s_d = mud/sd (U_d = mud, NO factor 2); margin = log10(theta/(barrier(s_d)*shape)); fluid = margin > 0

inputs.tissue_box_source: tissue_overlay_table.json (art 47c769d9); log-uniform draws within each stated box (round-8 protocol, run_placement_mc.py)

barrier_profile.source: ridge_profile_analysis_pool.parquet (art 4b92d826), full 2,856-run pooled anchor, replicated to max|diff|=0 vs deposit
barrier_profile.bootstrap: run-level joint bootstrap, B=3000, one shared anchor draw across the five rungs per replicate; each MC draw uses ONE joint replicate (rung correlations preserved), barrier interpolated linearly in log-log between rungs
barrier_profile.lowest_rung_open_endedness: s_d = 0.0025 is the lowest MEASURED rung; the ridge/anchor ratio still exceeds 1/2 there (0.63 loglin, 0.64 isotonic) so it is a crossover but no rung exists below it. Below s_d = 0.0025 the barrier is unmeasured: arm 'clamp' continues theta*(0.0025) as a constant (lower bound if the low-s_d rise continues), arm 'slope' continues the per-replicate 0.0025->0.005 log-log slope (barrier keeps rising). Fraction of draws below the measured range is reported per tissue as frac_extrapolated_sd.
barrier_profile.lowest_rung_bimodality: loglin bootstrap at s_d=0.0025 is bimodal (2.5th percentile 0.293 from a spurious first-crossing at the theta=0.30 local dip; isotonic PAVA crossing 0.637 [0.514, 0.840] is the shelf-robust interval) — both profiles are carried as separate arms

shape_correction.arm_off: shape multiplier fixed to 1 (no elongation penalty)

deleterious_fraction_arms.meaning: U_d box scaled by the factor: 0.1x = ten-fold FEWER deleterious targets per division, 10x = ten-fold more

arm_naming: prof_{loglin|isotonic}__extrap_{clamp|slope}__shape_{on|off}__del_{0.1|1|10}x, plus RE_tau_draw comparison arms (round-8-style N(log RE, tau=0.23) barrier draw, s_d-agnostic)

barrier_multipliers.definition: factor by which the whole barrier (ridge*shape) must be scaled up to bring P(fluid) down to q; loglin profile, clamp extrapolation

headline.verdict: FOR: with the measured five-rung bootstrap in place of the tau=0.23 heterogeneity model, every tissue is fluid-side with P >= 0.9999 at the stated deleterious fraction under every profile/extrapolation/shape arm; only the 10x-fewer-deleterious-targets arm on the colon drops (to 0.70-0.95)
